title: TimeBlind: A Spatio-Temporal Compositionality Benchmark for Video LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models using a question paired with only one randomly sampled video frame to assess if they rely on static frames rather than sequential modeling.
Evaluating models by providing only the question without any visual input to measure their reliance on textual plausibility and language patterns.
Evaluating models by providing the question with temporally shuffled video frames to test if they exploit static visual cues that happen to correlate with temporal dynamics.
